primary_context: FIRST_B same biological subject and session, deterministic cache order; no labels; disjoint outcomes

decoder.selection: TRAIN subject-held-out pseudo-target S2, subject-equal BA; same grid for ABS and REL; deterministic smallest-C tie break

train_selection: TRAIN subject-held-out pseudo-target S2 episodes, pooled subject-equal BA; select B and lambda before any OUTER EEG read; smallest B/lambda tie break

gates.A: class-relation cosine gain >=0.05 or drift reduction >=10%; >=4/5 folds
gates.B: pooled REL-ABS BA>=0.010, positive >=4/5 folds, subject-bootstrap lower95>0
gates.D: real > wrong-reference p95 >=4/5 or paired CI>0

mathematical_invariant: For any session-constant r, (c1-r)-(c0-r)=c1-c0 exactly. Gate A is unattainable for REL_MEAN under the specified class-relation metric.
